name: Iran nuclear programme
summary: Iran refuses nuclear talks until its conditions are met; Revolutionary Guards warn on doctrine
state: Two Middle East officials said on 7 Nov that Iran is reviewing Qatari proposals on the nuclear dispute but still refuses nuclear talks until core conditions such as lifting the US port blockade are met (Euronews). A Revolutionary Guards spokesman said on 7 Nov that Iran would respond if its leadership changed nuclear doctrine, and the US offered up to $20m for information on the programme on 6 Nov (RFE/RL). No strike on a nuclear site was reported.
for_you: No direct public-safety effect outside the region. Check FCDO travel advice for Iran and the Gulf.
rubric_hit: 60% enrichment stock, no IAEA access = Watch

sources.title: Euronews — US launches new targeted strikes on Iran as Trump claims progress in talks
RFE/RL — Iran live blog: US forces disable ship seeking to break blockade

why: A nuclear-armed Iran — or strikes to prevent one — could ignite the Gulf and send oil far higher.
drivers: Enrichment levels, IAEA access, Israeli/US military posture, snapback sanctions, talks.

rubric.alert: Strikes on nuclear sites, NPT withdrawal, or evidence of weaponisation.
rubric.watch: Enrichment at ≥ 60% or inspector access curtailed, or credible strike threats.
rubric.normal: IAEA access and active diplomacy; no escalation.
